name: Eurasian teal
note: The teal (B3 wave 3; doc 12 winter, doc 13 'Shaped, not found'; Matt's B3 calls of October 30, 2026): a small winter flock on a reedy pond you dug, once the frogs are asleep, gone again in early spring. A seasonal life beside the tier species: it counts toward no tier milestone, but it is the one B3 creature with a gift (the green wing feather at the flock's 0.5, made into the teal hat). BODY: the bird is recipes/birds/<body.birds>.json, Matt's model skinned to the small-bird rig (src/world/teal/model.js), drawn at displayScale (the findable scale; a real teal is about 0.36 m, drawn 0.72 m: 2 times, Matt, November 2, 2026), the flock file (teal-flock.glb) for every bird, with the hen's textured draw. contactShadow 0: it sits on water or flies. ECOLOGY (kind flock, src/world/creatures/flock.js): the minnows' arc in the hourly tick (a sign, settling, growing, uneasy, leaving) with the pond as its one pool: home is what the live look last measured (src/app/teal.js records state.creatures.teals.home: met, the pond's square metres, its middle), so room is one bird per arrival.m2PerOne square metres, up to company.n[2]. A pond that loses its reeds or water fails the home: they grow uneasy and leave after leaveGraceDays. dormancy teals (recipes/world/seasons.json): away north and east to breed from early spring to the start of winter, so they come only after the frogs sleep (frogs 2.6). visit: the S0 visit (src/world/ecology/visits.js) to any dug pond until the home is made; home: a dug pond of at least areaM2 with reeds, rushes or iris along that share of its edge (src/world/ecology/shaped.js pondsOf). gift: the green wing feather (the speculum), given once at the flock's group moment (presence.knownTrust, creature:known; src/world/expansion.js); src/app/teal.js puts it in a pouch, or on the gift stone once that stands. LIFE (src/world/teal/live.js): on the water within the pond's reach (life.pondReachK times the radius of its area, never where it is shallower than minDepthM): swimming at swimMps, dabbling, up-ending, preening, floating (shares of what comes next); at night most sleep (sleepShare). floatM: how deep the body rides (real metres under the surface at the feet's level). The flush (presence at Wary, the walker only, never the camera): each bird rises a riseLagS after the last, flies a lap of lapS round the pond circleOutM out at flyMps and flyUpM high, and lands (landS, skidding skidM) on the water furthest from you; inFromM: how far off a bird that comes later starts its glide in. Past Wary a bird inside the ring swims to the far side instead. At their group moment, with you still within joinM, they swim in around you (around.nearM..farM). spacingM: no two on the water closer than this.

presence._trust: Their trust (F13 section 8): one for the flock, 0..1, saved (state.creatures.teals.trust), only ever grows, earned by quiet watching only. bands: where Tolerant, Curious and Familiar begin; ceiling Curious. knownTrust: the group moment (creature:known) and their gift.

feed.none: The teal would rather sieve their own food from the shallows.
